I am an old woman, and my bones are not strong like before. Cassava does not need fancy chemicals or expensive seeds—it grows even when the rains are shy. My children and grandchildren will help me clear the plot with hoes, plant the cuttings we have kept from last season, and pull the weeds when the soil is soft. I have no money to pay workers, and the lake rains will be enough.
